note: Product-neutral fixtures for registries/operating-model/workspace-compatibility-qualification.schema.json and scripts/lib/workspace-compatibility-qualification.mjs. Every `valid` registry must pass evaluateWorkspaceCompatibilityQualification with no problem; every `invalid` registry must produce at least one. connection_record_resolution/plan_record_resolution/export_record_resolution are THIS package's own external boundaries (resolveConnectionRecord/resolvePlanRecord/resolveExportRecord), keyed by the opaque `reference` string each pinned_ref carries. migration_resolution/export_resolution are the COMPOSED contracts' own resolution maps (unchanged shape from instance-data-migration.fixtures.json / instance-canonical-export.fixtures.json), reused verbatim so the files never drift silently apart. Every pinned_ref.sha256 (workspace_connection_ref included) is the REAL, recomputed output of computeConnectionDigest/computePlanFingerprint/computeExportDigest over the pinned record's own content — never an arbitrary value. The nine `valid` entries are the nine table rows of the decision matrix (workspace-compatibility-qualification.md §4.1, eight logical steps — resolve-conflict and resolve-ambiguity share one step) — a separate, smaller claim than the program's eight acceptance scenarios (§4.2), which are proven by dedicated, mostly non-fixture tests in test/workspace-compatibility-qualification.test.mjs. No product literals, no absolute machine paths, no dependency on a separate Instance.
